 Start with a $55 bonus by signing up with Kalshi promo code WTOP55 and trading $25 on the NBA. This is one of the top options on the market for NBA fans this week. New users will have the chance to secure $55 in bonuses to use on Kings-Spurs, Knicks-Pistons, Lakers-Trail Blazers or any other game.
 Get $50 in Trade Credits With Novig Promo Code WTOP
 On a traditional sportsbook, you pay the vig on every trade. On a peer-to-peer exchange, you do not, because you are matched against another user rather than a house. Take the 231.5 consensus total. Standard platforms price it at -110 (a 52.4% implied probability), but removing the vig shifts your return closer to a true even money 50% implied probability (+100). A $10 deposit unlocks $50 in trade credits.
 Claim $25 Bonus With Polymarket Promo Code WTOP
 Prices shift constantly on this exchange, allowing traders to monitor real-time momentum. Shares read directly as probability, and a key advantage is that a position can be sold before the game ends to secure profit or cut losses. Standard NBA coverage typically features moneyline, spread, and totals action. The market will react instantly to every run, foul, and rotation change during the contest. All it takes is a $10 qualifying deposit to unlock the $25 bonus.
 OG Promo Code WTOP Unlocks $50 in Bonus Picks
 Variety is a great tool to have in your back pocket as you dive into prediction market platforms. The exact same outcome is priced differently from venue to venue, so holding more accounts means more shots at finding the better side of an identical trade. A $25 trade unlocks the $50 in bonus picks.
 ProphetX Promo Code WTOP: Trade $50, Get $75 Bonus
 If you have a specific read on this game and want a line the broader market isn’t posting, this exchange offers a direct solution. You simply request your preferred price and wait for another user to fill the contract. Place a $50 qualifying trade to secure the $75 bonus. This is the largest sign-up bonus of any prediction market platform listed here.
 Use Prediction Markets for Sacramento Kings vs. San Antonio Spurs
 The 0-3 Sacramento Kings visit the 1-2 San Antonio Spurs in a matchup defined by massive defensive disparities. Sacramento has struggled immensely to stop opponents this season, surrendering 124.0 points per game, while the Spurs allow a much lower 112.0 points defensively.
 Sacramento is missing Keegan Murray (ankle) and Ben Simmons (achilles), absences that drastically reduce their two-way upside and overall rotation depth. San Antonio is missing Tobias Harris (calf), though their core remains largely intact.
 San Antonio games have hit the under in all three contests this year, while the Kings have gone over the total in two of their three outings. Given Sacramento’s winless start, porous defense, and missing playmakers, the underlying metrics strongly support San Antonio’s steep 92.5% implied market probability to win outright.
